description: Ho, <name>.  I heard that Ragnar Thunderbrew is steaming mad about someone stealing his ale.  He's looking for stalwart adventurers, and willing to pay plenty.
Talk to Ragnar if you're interested.  He's at the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos, in Dun Morogh.
completion: You're right I'm mad!  I've been robbed!  Robbed of one of our family recipes!  How dare they!  As if I didn't have enough cause to hate the Dark Iron dwarves!  Now, oh... now they're in for it!

note: Introductory step leading to Hurley Blackbreath.
pickup: Enohar Thunderbrew, Nethergarde Keep, Blasted Lands
